headers: D8: residence for foreign remote work
rows: Retirees or people living on property, intellectual-property or investment income. No qualifying passive income was stated for this family.

Employees or independent professionals working remotely for entities/persons domiciled outside Portugal. Chidi’s described job fits this purpose; Ngozi’s foreign-client activity may also fit, but amount/client details are unknown.
100% of wage: conditional €970/month; annual illustration 970×12=€11,640. Source and regularity matter, not only savings.
Average professional income in the preceding three months ≥4×wage: 4×970=€3,880/month; annual equivalent €46,560, not a separate annual test.

Demonstrate the 4M principal professional-income test and stable sufficient accompanying-family resources. The family subsistence reference is €2,037/month. These overlapping tests are not an automatically additive bill or a verified 4M×2.1 household threshold. Toronto’s documentary treatment remains unverified.
Recurring pension/rent/investment/IP evidence and corresponding receipts; savings-only acceptance not established.
Employment contract or employer declaration; professional-income proof over three months; tax-residence document. For freelance activity: service/company contract or proof of services.
Residence visa is the entry step, not the residence card.
Choose the residence D8 route, not the separate temporary-stay remote-work visa, for this two-year move.
CAD 25 federal fee per adult, plus fingerprint-provider charges; two adult federal fees = CAD 50. Electronic no-match cases: ≤3 business days; manual/match cases: 120 business days; mailing extra.
Do not time this as a guaranteed one-week task. Confirm certificate freshness before ordering.

Snapshot, not a 2027 service guarantee. Courier/notary/translation costs separate.
